Container.Name: patzer
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: chess stockfish game review lichess chess.com ollama llm coach family kids
Container.Overview:
Patzer is a self-hosted chess app: import your public Chess.com games (or play in the browser) and get a full Game Review computed by the bundled Stockfish - move classifications from Brilliant to Blunder, accuracy, estimated Elo, an eval graph, key moments and engine lines.
The AI coach is optional and points at your own Ollama or vLLM host, so nothing is sent to a cloud service. It is render-only: every chess fact is computed by Stockfish and chess.js, and the model is only allowed to phrase what it is given, which is why a small local model works without inventing pieces that are not on the board.
Also included: play against Stockfish at seven strength tiers, live games against other people on your server (draw offers, takebacks, rematch), multi-user profiles with a kid mode, and English, Bulgarian and Spanish in both the interface and the coach.
Everything is in one container with a single SQLite file in /app/data - back that up and you have your whole history. No telemetry, no account, MIT licensed.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database and the session secret. Back this up.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true when you put Patzer behind a reverse proxy that terminates TLS.

Config.Name: STOCKFISH_PATH
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty - the image ships Stockfish.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address people use to reach Patzer, e.g. https://chess.example.com. Needed for single sign-on behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on: issuer URL of your OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Keycloak, ...), exactly as the provider shows it. See docs/OIDC.md.

Config.Name: OIDC_BUTTON_TEXT
Config.Description: Single sign-on: label of the button on the login page. Empty = Sign in with SSO.

Config.Name: OIDC_ONLY
Config.Description: Single sign-on: true removes password login, sign-up and password reset; a fresh install skips the setup wizard and the first SSO login is the admin.

Config.Name: OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP
Config.Description: Single sign-on: provider group whose members are admins, e.g. patzer-admins.

Config.Name: OIDC_AUTO_PROVISION
Config.Description: Single sign-on: true creates an account for new people the provider lets in.

Config.Name: OIDC_MATCH_BY
Config.Description: Single sign-on: link a first login to an existing account by username, email or none.

Config.Name: LICHESS_EXPLORER_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Point the Master games panel at a self-hosted lila-openingexplorer instead of the public one.
